create_unconstrained_affine_bijector: create an UnconstrainedAffine bijector with a square matrix and bias vector for linear transformations
forward_affine_transformation: compute the forward transformation y = Ax + b using the UnconstrainedAffine bijector forward method
inverse_affine_transformation: compute the inverse transformation x = A^-1(y - b) using the UnconstrainedAffine bijector inverse method
compute_forward_log_det_jacobian: compute the log absolute determinant of the forward Jacobian using forward_log_det_jacobian
check_affine_parameters: validate that a matrix is square and a bias vector shape matches using check_affine_parameters
